name: @mirrorz/desktop

scripts.build: npm run build:renderer && npm run build:shell
scripts.test: vitest run --config vitest.config.ts && vitest run --config vitest.main.config.ts
scripts.dev:electron: npm run build:shell && cross-env-less MIRRORZ_DEV_SERVER=http://localhost:5273 electron .
scripts.build:shell: vite build --config vite.main.config.ts && vite build --config vite.preload.config.ts

description: MIRRORZ Sheets desktop shell (Electron main process, preload bridge and renderer)
